architecture: formal QA absorption signal in QA scorecard
business_flow: Beacon loads frozen requirement truth and current QA evidence for that feature.
If any required source is missing, Beacon returns a blocked admission with the missing surface and route recommendation.
If sources exist, Beacon builds findings and binds each finding to affected AC IDs and current evidence refs.
If a finding has no AC or evidence binding, Beacon blocks the report instead of returning a ready skeleton.
Operator routes blocked findings to change, test-case, implement, or QA as recommended.
Formal QA records whether each finding was absorbed, deferred, blocked, or not applicable.
Release readiness summarizes only absorbed findings as release supplement input.
decision_priority: Skill Eval replay failure blocks eval pass.
Formal QA absorption controls release supplement eligibility.
Advisory deep findings may influence exploration but cannot count as pass evidence.
